items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: make a record with Benny Goodman with Teddy Wilson on

ctx.x: Just play and think like him. See, I didn't have -- I couldn't think like a lot of guys like Sid Catlett, Jo Jones. Even old Krupa wasn't no slouch, you know. He was a digger. He played good drums. I had the fortune to play -- make a record with Benny Goodman with Teddy Wilson on

the piano and Jimmy Crawford on drums. Now, I don't know who was on bass. Maybe Pemberton or somebody. I don't recall. Or Jack -- bass player that played with Goodman's band, good bass player, and just what Quincy Jones said about he hired Jimmy Crawford and Milt Hinton to make a record date with him, not to play in a band. He didn't have a band then. That was before he went to Hollywood.
